image_description: A vintage, antique-style cast iron smoothing iron (sad iron) resting on a neutral fabric background. The object features a heavy, blocky rectangular body with a curved top handle that has a wooden or wood-effect grip. There is a small lever or knob on the front left side. The soleplate appears to have decorative cutouts or vents along the side and bottom edge, rather than modern steam holes. The texture is rough, pitted, and metallic, suggesting aged cast iron.

The scalloped cutouts along the side of the iron's body lack clear depth and internal structure. They appear as flat, painted-on shapes rather than physical holes cut through thick metal, suggesting a failure in 3D geometric modeling.

The bottom edge of the iron does not sit perfectly flat on the surface; there is slight ambiguity in the contact shadow, making it look like it's floating slightly or melting into the background cloth.
